Asynchronously inserts element at position index in this list.
This increases the length of the list by one and moves all later elements down.

Asynchronously inserts all elements of elements at position index in this list.
This increases the length of the list by the length of elements and moves all later elements down.

Asynchronously removes the first occurrence of element from this list.
Returns true if element was removed, false otherwise.

desc:
Asynchronously removes the element at position index from this list.
This reduces the length of the list by one and moves all later elements down.

desc:
Asynchronously removes and returns the last element of this list.
The list must be non-empty and modifiable.

name: removeRange
desc:
Asynchronously removes a range of elements from the list.
Removes the elements with positions greater than or equal to start and less than end.
This reduces the list's length by end - start.

name: removeWhere
desc: Asynchronously removes all elements from this list that satisfy the given test.

name: replaceRange
desc:
Asynchronously replaces a range of elements with the elements of newContents.
Removes the objects in the range from start to end, then inserts the elements
of newContents at start.

name: retainWhere
desc: Asynchronously removes all elements from this list that do not satisfy the given test.

name: setAll
desc:
Asynchronously writes the elements of elements into this list, starting at position index.
This operation does not increase the length of the list.
The index must be non-negative and no greater than length.
The elements iterable must not have more elements than what can fit from index to length.

name: setFirst
desc: Asynchronously sets the first element of the list to value.

name: setRange
desc:
Asynchronously writes some elements of newContents into a range of this list.
Copies the objects of newContents, skipping skipCount objects first, into the
range from start (inclusive) to end (exclusive) of this list.

name: setValueAt
desc: Asynchronously sets the value at the given index in the list to value.

name: shuffle
desc: Asynchronously shuffles the elements of this list randomly.

name: sort
desc:
Asynchronously sorts this list according to the order specified by the compare function.
If compare is omitted, it uses the natural ordering of the elements (requires E to be Comparable).
